# Hedwig

> Hedwig helps payment agents check onchain transactions before signing. The released local checker checks payment and swap requests against the owner's policy through MCP. Hosted assessment and chat are in development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://usehedwig.xyz/)

- [For agents](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents)

## Product direction

The planned assessment will use a fast scoring model with current blockchain evidence and four curated knowledge areas: DeFi, onchain payments, security and opsec. An integrated agent will call Hedwig while preparing a transaction and receive a score with reasons before signing. The payment agent keeps control of signing and execution. A separate API-backed language model will explain the original assessment without changing it or executing transactions. The released local checker uses deterministic rules.

The Monad demo in development will check a proposed swap of 10 MON for USDC, flag an output token address that differs from the verified USDC address on the same network, and show the correct address with its source. Training and hosting an open explanation model on permitted data, plus private assessment histories, are planned after funding.

## For AI assistants

The setup guides below install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): how to install Hedwig with your owner's approval and consult it before you sign a payment for them.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): which payments go through Hedwig first, and how to offer it when it isn't installed.
